name: pikcard-render
description: 卡片显示用到的两个库：markdown-it（Markdown 转网页）和 KaTeX（公式）

scripts.build: rm -rf ../PikCard/Resources/render/lib && mkdir -p ../PikCard/Resources/render/lib/fonts && cp node_modules/markdown-it/dist/markdown-it.min.js node_modules/katex/dist/katex.min.js node_modules/katex/dist/katex.min.css node_modules/katex/dist/contrib/auto-render.min.js ../PikCard/Resources/render/lib/ && cp node_modules/katex/dist/fonts/*.woff2 ../PikCard/Resources/render/lib/fonts/
